scenes.narration: We asked two models for a number from one to ten, thirty times each. A fair pick lands on each number about three times.

scenes.visual_objective: Show the prompt, the number of asks and what a fair pick would look like

scenes.narration: Google's Flash-Lite said seven, thirty times out of thirty. OpenAI's GPT-OSS said seven, thirty times. A random pick would vary, but this did not.

scenes.narration: From one to a hundred, Google's Flash-Lite chose forty-two most often, twenty-six times.

scenes.visual_objective: Show each model's most common replies from one to a hundred
